EmailTemplate.subject: Last Chance REMINDER: New Client Dashboard Q&A
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
[Virtual Q&A]
New Improved Client Dashboard Same information. Enhanced functionality. More intuitive design. We hope you’ve been enjoying using the new dashboard <[[https://dashboard-new.flywire.com/login?fromOldApp=true?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> over the past few months. Beginning June 2nd, the former dashboard will be retired, and all users will be required to use the new dashboard.
Learn more about the new dashboard here <[[https://dashboard-new.flywire.com/learn-more?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, and join our virtual Q&A sessions <[[https://more.flywire.com/NewClientDashboard-QASession.html?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> on May 19th at 8am PDT | 11am EDT | 4pm BST to get all your dashboard questions answered!
<[[https://more.flywire.com/NewClientDashboard-QASession.html?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
If you’re unable to join our Q&A session, simply log in to our Help Center <[[https://help.client.flywire.com/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> for additional resources, or contact your Relationship Manager with any questions.
